title: Sam Beers, Joe Glaser and hard times
summary: His manager Sam Beers blocked a California offer and sold his contract to Joe Glaser; Roy pawned a ring to move the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: In the meantime, I got an offer to go out to California with Bing Crosby's brother. And everything was going along great, except the guy didn't want me to leave, you know, because we was doin' business for him. So he stopped it. How he stopped it I'm not too sure yet, but he did.

Yeah, and he stopped it. He also sold my contract to Joe Glaser, unbeknownst to me. See, because what happened with him, the union said his contract was null and void. Right? So to get out of that, he sold it to Joe Glaser. I mean, he had it here in New York, waiting for the moment to swoop down on me, which he did.

So we got to the Deuces and worked around, and it was kind of hard times then. It just shows you, man. I won and Down Beat Award and couldn't get arrested. I had a ring, a diamond ring, and I pawned it. I must have pawned it to get the band out of town twenty times.
